newsitem.title: USA: Nuevo sees reaching replacement goal.
newsitem.headline: Nuevo sees reaching replacement goal.

text.p: Nuevo Energy Co said Tuesday that based on drilling results for the first half of 1997, the company is well on its way to achieving a goal of a 200 percent production replacement rate in 1997.
The company attributed the progress to five exploration discoveries and better-than-expected development results in the first half of the year.
In a statement, Nuevo President Mike Watford said the results indicate the company will have its best-ever year in terms of drill bit reserve additions.
The company said it has made significant discoveries in the Republic of Congo, offshore West Africa, and onshore and offshore California. Development successes include several projects in Califonria.
